opportunities.name_zh: 小樽運河石造倉庫與運河景觀
opportunities.best_time: 白天至日落前（景點當地時間／JST）

condition_variants.variant_name: 淺草橋街園運河與石造倉庫
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"浅草橋街園 Camera Zone","subject":"curving canal + historic stone warehouses"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法公共步行區可達；可見光時段；無明確封閉
condition_variants.required_conditions: 運河與石造倉庫輪廓清楚；能見度足夠；低雲或降水未嚴重遮蔽主體
condition_variants.boosters: 低角度斜光；薄雲柔光；低霾；較少人潮
condition_variants.penalties: 濃霧；強降雨／降雪造成主體遮蔽；能見度明顯不足

viewpoints.note: Official tourism identifies Asakusa Bridge Garden as the representative Otaru Canal photography spot; coordinate cross-checked to mapped POI.
viewpoints.name: 浅草橋街園 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 淺草橋街園及橋頭公共拍攝區；代表 Camera Zone，不宣稱唯一腳架點。

opportunities.name_zh: 小樽運河暮色瓦斯燈與倉庫點燈
opportunities.best_time: 日落後至22:30（景點當地時間／JST；倉庫群點燈至22:30，散策路瓦斯燈至24:00）
opportunities.best_season: 全年；特殊活動另依官方公告

condition_variants.variant_name: 暮色運河＋瓦斯燈＋石造倉庫點燈
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"浅草橋街園 Camera Zone","subject":"canal + gas lamps + illuminated stone warehouses"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法公共步行區可達；官方常態點燈時段；暮色／夜間時段有效
condition_variants.required_conditions: 運河與倉庫群可辨；能見度足夠；官方常態點燈時段成立
condition_variants.boosters: 藍調時段保留天空色階；低風可增加水面穩定感但完美倒影不是必要條件
condition_variants.penalties: 濃霧；強降水／降雪遮蔽；超出倉庫群點燈時段；臨時停止點燈
